intent: The personal website and kcd2 dice solver static Caddies serve their prerendered dist/ so both sites pass the AgentReady v2.0 checker (real 404s, discovery files, ai-catalog Link header), and a narrow sudo-free redeploy + verify exists for the three public static sites.
scope: linux_configuration/features/lib/static_site_caddy.sh (new shared site-block body), website_build.sh, kcd2_serve.sh, kcd2_expose.sh
Non-goal: no edge Caddy, sudo, pacman or rebuild changes; site content lives in each site's own repo
changes: static_site_caddy.sh: one Caddy site-block body for both static sites (prerendered paths, real 404 via handle_errors, ai-catalog Link header) plus a dist/ presence guard; website_build.sh and kcd2_serve.sh render it instead of two drifting SPA catch-alls
kcd2_serve.sh readiness wait requires HTTP 200 with a body, so the non-empty 404 page no longer counts as ready
setup_* `serve`: re-render the inner compose + Caddyfile and recreate only that site's container
redeploy_agent_ready_sites.sh: serve both sites, restart the popes-site user unit, then run agent_ready url against each public URL (--verify-only skips the redeploy)

verification.evidence: static-site serve: 26 passed, 0 failed; redeploy agent-ready sites: 15 passed, 0 failed
e2e agent-ready website: 16 passed, 0 failed; e2e agent-ready dice: 16 passed, 0 failed (real caddy:2.8 container serving a copy of each dist/)
PASS kuhy.duckdns.org, dice.kuhy.duckdns.org, popes.kuhy.duckdns.org (rc=0); an earlier run hit the 10 s per-site CHECK_TIMEOUT on all three while the checker alone took 2-22 s

verification.command: shellcheck -x on all 10 changed/new scripts; pre-commit run on the staged files

risks: CHECK_TIMEOUT=10 in redeploy_agent_ready_sites.sh is tight: live checks took up to 22 s, which reports FAIL (timed out) on a healthy site
A `serve` with no dist/ is refused before docker runs; a stale dist/ is still served as-is
rollback: git revert the commit, then run setup_personal_website.sh / setup_kcd2_dice_solver.sh to re-render the old Caddyfiles
curl both sites and check the landing page returns 200
